findings.message: R code loads DescTools, NlcOptim, RJDemetra, ggh4x, ggplot2, ggthemes, p, ragg, readxl, scales, systemfonts, vars, zoo with no renv.lock. A rerun installs current CRAN versions and must log them.

`2025-12-md.csv` is not in the package; the documentation (data/README.md, data/raw/README.md) says to download it from https://actuariesclimateindex.org, https://actuariesclimateindex.org/terms-of-use/, https://www.nber.org/research/data/us-business-cycle-expansions-and-contractions. The download date and the file's SHA-256 become part of the receipt; links were not checked (use --check-links).

The documentation claims a run time of about 422640 hours, over this desk's budget of 24 hours (--max-hours). A full rerun needs a compute plan; a partial rerun must say which parts it skipped.
5 file reads use paths built at run time (macros, globs, variables), so triage could not check that those inputs exist.
The documentation mentions restricted data ("confidential") but every input triage could trace is present. Check by hand that no restricted file is read through a path triage could not resolve.
The package mentions a cluster or batch scheduler; scripts may assume one.
